newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - Jan 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - Jan 17.

text.p: The Daily Variety reported the following items on the front page of its Friday, January 17 edition:

* News Corp Ltd chairman Rupert Murdoch did not rule out a possible bid for the Los Angeles Dogders Major League Baseball team, which was put up for sale by the O'Malley family earlier this month. Murdoch told an industry luncheon that he was "hesitating" about whether to buy the team, but he indicated that price and synergy are key issues about a possible bid.
* Australian director Stephan Elliott has signed an agreement to direct "Eye of the Beholder."

* Viacom Inc has signed a deal with Westinghouse Electric Corp's WCBS-TV affiliate in New York to move Real TV into Hard Copy's 7 p.m. access slot this fall. The deal means the positioning of Real TV as Paramount's next big access contender and the possible key to holding access slots on the CBS stations beyond 1998. Hard Copy will move to the 4:30 p.m. early fringe slot.
* Tele-Communications Inc will reinstate A&E and the Nashville Network to its systems in Houston, Texas, where the networks had been dropped, and to relaunch MTV in its Grand Junction, Colorado.

* Filmmaker Scott Reynolds's Heaven for Dimension Films will star Martin Donovan, Richard Schiff, Joanna Going, Patrick Malahide and Danny Edwards. The film starts shooting January 19 in Auckland, New Zealand.
* Time Warner Inc's Warner Bros has promoted Charlotte Kandel to executive vice president of theatrical publicity and promotion.
